dominant_strengths: Confident large display type sets a clear hero hierarchy and reads cleanly across the wide centered column
Restrained monochrome palette plus a single violet CTA creates an unambiguous primary action focus
Logo bar uses consistent grayscale lockups, giving the social-proof row a tidy, uniform rhythm
dominant_weaknesses: Faint circuit-board background pattern feels generic and clichéd for a devtools brand, undermining distinctiveness
Massive vertical whitespace around the headline leaves the hero feeling empty rather than intentionally airy
Subhead line breaks awkwardly with orphaned 'your business.' creating a ragged, unbalanced paragraph shape
fix_priorities: Replace the decorative circuit pattern with a more proprietary visual artifact (product UI, auth flow, code) to show, not tell
Tighten hero vertical rhythm and rebalance subhead measure to eliminate the orphan
Introduce a secondary CTA or product preview to add behavioral depth below the fold tease
Push a signature accent or motion moment to lift visceral and distinctiveness scores
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity is solid via the obvious CTA, but visceral spark and reflective memorability are weak due to generic decoration.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a competent devtools landing page for Clerk but lacks the craft signals expected from a category-leading auth brand.
